name: Unidentified pirate capital ship
description: A pirate capital ship crewed entirely by decommissioned battle droids that dated back to the Clone Wars wrought havoc in the Tashtor sector during the reign of the Galactic Empire. In 3 ABY, the Imperial Navy seized the capital ship and sent the pirate droids for termination. The seizure was then reported on the HoloNet News by reporter Dorna Parros.
